# apx-agent

> Write a Databricks AI agent once. Deploy to Databricks Apps (the default) or Mosaic AI Model Serving with one flag. Per-user OAuth identity passthrough flows through every UC function, Genie space, Vector Search index, and sub-agent call — Unity Catalog enforces *their* grants on *their* data, no auth code at the tool level.

apx-agent is a Python + TypeScript framework for authoring Databricks AI agents. Author your agent in a single `agent.py` or `agent.ts`; the framework picks the runtime contract (`ChatAgent` for Mosaic AI Model Serving, `ResponsesAgent` for Databricks Apps) and the OBO chain normalizes whichever auth shape the runtime injects. The same agent code, same tools, and same `apx.*` MLflow trace schema apply either way.

**Use it when** the user is building an AI agent on Databricks that needs (1) per-user identity passthrough so each caller sees only their own UC-governed data, (2) governed primitives (UC functions, Genie spaces, Vector Search) wired as Mosaic AI resources so deploy mints scoped tokens automatically, or (3) the same agent runnable both as a Databricks App and a Model Serving endpoint. Pick **Apps** as the default (FastAPI + `/mcp` + `/_apx/*` dev UI, easier to ship); pick **Model Serving** when registering with Unity Catalog (`--name catalog.schema.agent`) and consuming the endpoint from notebooks, jobs, or AI/BI.

**Core primitives:** `Agent` (LLM agent with tools and instructions); `uc_function_tool`, `genie_tool`, `vector_search_tool` (governed tool builders that auto-declare as Mosaic AI resources); `SequentialAgent`, `ParallelAgent`, `LoopAgent`, `RouterAgent`, `HandoffAgent` (deterministic workflow composition); `agent_tool` (wrap any local or remote agent as an LLM-callable tool — URL shorthand auto-wraps remote endpoints via A2A discovery); session stores (`LakebaseSessionStore`, `DeltaSessionStore`, `InMemorySessionStore`) plus `MemoryBank` for durable cross-session recall and `ExampleStore` for few-shot retrieval.

**Dev loop:** `apx scaffold my-agent` → edit `agent.py` in your IDE → `apx run --reload` (FastAPI on `localhost:8000`, hot reload, `/_apx/*` dev UI for traces, eval, tool editor, topology graph, setup wizard) → `apx deploy` when ready to share. Local dev runs against *real* Databricks under the developer's own OAuth token, so what works locally works deployed.

**Install (from GitHub — not yet on PyPI / npm; the Python package lives in the `python/` subdirectory so the install URL needs `#subdirectory=python`):**

```bash
uv add "apx-agent[langgraph] @ git+https://github.com/stuagano/apx-agent.git@v0.2.2#subdirectory=python"
```

**Minimal agent:**

```python
from apx_agent import Agent, uc_function_tool, genie_tool

agent = Agent(
    instructions="Investigate customer accounts.",
    tools=[
        uc_function_tool("main.tools.lookup_account"),
        genie_tool("abc123", description="Answer billing questions"),
    ],
)
```

**Deploy:**

```bash
apx deploy                                            # default target: Databricks Apps
apx deploy --target model-serving --name main.agents.account_lookup
```

**Common pitfalls to flag for users:** (1) Don't pip-install `apx-agent` from PyPI — it isn't published there yet; use the GitHub URL with `#subdirectory=python`. (2) Don't write auth code inside tools — the framework's per-request client already forwards the calling user's OAuth token; if a query returns nothing because the caller lacks `SELECT`, that's governance working, not a bug. (3) Don't hard-code the runtime contract (`ChatAgent` vs `ResponsesAgent`) — write to the `Agent` API and let `apx deploy --target {apps,model-serving}` pick. (4) Sharing an agent with a team takes three steps: share the App, each user consents once to the OBO scopes, then each user's UC grants apply automatically. (5) On private-link / FEVM workspaces, MLflow trace blob storage URLs (`*.storage.cloud.databricks.com`) are blocked — pass `include_spans=False` when reading traces if calls silently return `[]`.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/README.md): Project overview, full feature matrix, architecture diagram, install, quick start
- [Getting Started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/getting-started.md): Install, first agent, local dev server, deploy to Apps or Model Serving
- [Apps vs Model Serving](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/apps-vs-model-serving.md): Decision criteria — when to pick each runtime target
- [Workflow Patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/workflow-patterns.md): SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent, LoopAgent, RouterAgent, HandoffAgent — decision criteria and full examples
- [Sessions + Memory Bank + Example Bank](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/sessions-and-memory.md): Multi-turn sessions (LakebaseSessionStore, DeltaSessionStore, InMemorySessionStore), durable MemoryBank, few-shot ExampleStore
- [Governed Primitives](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/governed-primitives.md): uc_function_tool, genie_tool, vector_search_tool — authoring and UC registration
- [Identity Passthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/identity-passthrough.md): OBO mechanics — how the caller's OAuth token flows through every tool call
- [MCP + A2A Discovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/mcp-and-a2a.md): /mcp endpoint, agent_tool, cross-endpoint sub-agent calls, RemoteAgent
- [Typed Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/typed-tools.md): @tool decorator, UC function publishing, Pydantic schemas
- [Dev UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/dev-ui.md): /_apx/* surfaces — traces, eval, tool editor, topology graph, setup wizard
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/configuration.md): pyproject.toml [tool.apx.agent] section, env vars, settings
- [Lakebase Recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/lakebase-recipe.md): Provisioning, pgvector, pool tuning, OAuth token rotation
- [Evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/evaluation.md): apx eval, evalset.jsonl, MLflow experiments, custom judges
- [Compliance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/compliance.md): WatchdogGuard adapter, audit log schema, local guards (RateLimit, ToolAllowlist, prompt_injection_heuristic)
- [Cost Tracking + Callbacks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/cost-and-callbacks.md): Cost callbacks, token tracking, usage hooks
- [Hub + Agent Publishing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/hub.md): apx publish, agent registry, AgentHub UI
- [Ecosystem](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/docs/ecosystem.md): How apx-agent fits among Mosaic AI Agent Framework, MLflow, ai_query, and other Databricks AI tools

## Examples

- [Examples Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/python/examples/EXAMPLES.md): 13 worked Python examples — memory_demo, customer_triage (HandoffAgent), data-triage-agent (6-step Sequential), data-inspector (MCP-callable), entity-resolution-agent (Vector Search + Supervisor + Evaluator), eligibility-agent (document parsing), contract-parsing-agent, shortage-intelligence-agent (5-step Sequential), explain-my-bill-agent, slack-agent, apx-builder (NL → deploy), agent-hub, voynich (LoopAgent + evolutionary population)
- [Hello World](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/python/hello-world/README.md): Minimal scaffolded Python agent — reference for the canonical project layout
- [apx-builder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stuagano/apx-agent/main/python/examples/apx-builder/README.md): Natural-language agent builder shipped as an example app — describe an agent in English and it scaffolds + deploys
